=== Revolutionary War ===
Benjamin served as a soldier from New Hampshire in the Revolutionary War, enlisting in 1775 in Captain Jacob Webster's company.<ref name="cilleydar">"U.S., Revolutionary War Burial Index, 1775-1875", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/63156/records/54562 : accessed 18 November 2026), Benjamin Silly [Cilley], died 9 Mar 1823 aged 82; enlisted 1775, Capt. Jacob Webster's company; buried Town Cemetery, Andover, New Hampshire; citing DAR annual reports to the U.S. Senate.</ref> The Sons of the American Revolution recognise him as a patriot.<ref name="cilleysar">"U.S., Sons of the American Revolution Patriots List, 1775-1783", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/63651/records/127733 : accessed 18 November 2026), Benjamin Cilley, soldier, New Hampshire; born 12 May 1742 Amesbury; died 9 Mar 1823 Andover NH; spouse Apphia Keniston; citing SAR Known Patriots, SAR membership no. 133056.</ref> He died at Andover on 9 March 1823, aged about 82, and was buried in the town cemetery there.<ref name="cilleydar"/>

=== Research Notes ===
* Still needed: the primary 1775 muster roll (New Hampshire State Papers, Rolls) for his regiment. No pension file was found.
